attribution.title: Callander station site geograph-3296618-by-Ben-Brooksbank
attribution.author: Ben Brooksbank
attribution.description:
Site of Callander station.
View NW, towards Balquhidder and Oban: ex-Caledonian Railway Dunblane - Callander - Balquhidder - Oban line, which closed Callander - Balquhidder from 28/9/65 after a disastrous landslide near Balquhidder, goods traffic from the east continuing to Callander until 1/11/65. In the background towers Beinn Bhreac (2,306 ft.).
